en: In the midst of the economic crisis, a strong earthquake shook Cuba: no victims or material damage were reported. An earthquake of magnitude 6.1 was felt in the west of the island, and, according to AFP journalists, it could be felt in Florida and the southeastern United States. Cuban authorities reported no victims.
la: In medio discrimine oeconomico fortis Cubae terrae motus concussit: nullae victimae vel damni materiales nuntiabantur. Motus magnitudinis 6.1 in insula occidentali sentiebatur et, secundum diurnarios AFP, in Florida et in Civitatibus Americae australibus sentiebatur. Auctoritates Cubanorum nullas victimas retulerunt.
